title: A spectral correlation inequality for increasing Boolean functions
summary: Talagrand's correlation inequality provides a quantitative strengthening of the Harris--Kleitman inequality for increasing Boolean functions. Motivated by a Fourier-analytic conjecture of Friedgut, Kahn, Kalai, and Keller, we prove that $$ \mathrm{Cov}(f,g)\ge 2\sum_{S\neq\emptyset}|S|\hat f(S)^2\hat g(S)^2 $$ holds for all increasing Boolean functions $f,g:\{0,1\}^n\to\{0,1\}$. The proof combines the reverse Bonami--Beckner inequality with Young's convolution inequality.
